tribe.name: Ironshield Tribe
tribe.text: West of the ridge, the Ironshield have walled a cold valley and crowned a warden-captain. They do not raid for hunger — they raid for ground, and they keep what they take.

preliminaries.name: Break the Border Patrol
preliminaries.text: Their shield-lines walk the west road in pairs. Break them before they warn the keep.

preliminaries.name: Silence the Watch Post
preliminaries.text: A stone watch answers every horn. Blind it, and the stronghold fights half-asleep.

intel.army: Shield infantry, wall-breakers, and a muster that answers every horn
intel.tactics: Holds the yard behind stone; summons breakers when pressed
intel.weakness: Slow to turn — siege craft and armor-piercing steel pay double
intel.reward: Break the keep and its valley, road and stores join the Manner.

annex.name: Rebuild as an Outpost
annex.text: A fortified regional base: two more of every building line may stand.

annex.name: Dismantle for Materials
annex.text: Strip the keep stone by stone — timber, plate and cold coin for the Manner.

annex.name: Frontier Settlement
annex.text: The valley feeds the Manner: quicker gathering hands and one more of every line.

tribes.name: Thornband
tribes.text: In Whisperwood, the Thornband lace forest paths with snares. Raiders and fast scouts strike from the briars, then vanish beneath the trees.

preliminaries.name: Cut the Snare Lines
preliminaries.text: Clear the snared paths before the scouts carry your approach to the hold.

preliminaries.name: Burn the Briar Camp
preliminaries.text: Break the raiders at their forest camp and silence the warning fires.

intel.army: Forest raiders and fast scouts slipping between the briars
intel.tactics: Rushes the yard and summons raiders when pressed
intel.weakness: Hold narrow paths with pikes and overlapping tower fire
intel.reward: The Whisperwood paths, timber and stores join the Manner.

annex.name: Rebuild as an Outpost
annex.text: A fortified forest base: two more of every building line may stand.

annex.name: Dismantle for Materials
annex.text: Strip the briar hold for seasoned timber, plate and cold coin.

annex.name: Frontier Settlement
annex.text: Forest homesteads feed the Manner and open one more of every building line.

tribes.name: Cinder Clan
tribes.text: In the hills of Ashfall March, the Cinder Clan hammer slag into walls and stoke their war forges. Wall-breakers march behind forge-fire, tearing down every road that refuses their captain.

preliminaries.name: Break the Slag Lines
preliminaries.text: Break the slag barricades before the wall-breakers reach the road.

preliminaries.name: Quench the Forge
preliminaries.text: Silence the war forge and cut the breakers off from fresh iron.

intel.army: Wall-breakers and forge guards marching through the ash
intel.tactics: Slams the yard and summons breakers to tear down defenses
intel.weakness: Keep repair crews behind overlapping pikes and tower fire
intel.reward: The Ashfall March roads, forge stores and hills join the Manner.

annex.name: Rebuild as an Outpost
annex.text: A fortified hill base: two more of every building line may stand.

annex.name: Dismantle for Materials
annex.text: Strip the citadel for forge timber, plate and cold coin.

annex.name: Frontier Settlement
annex.text: Hill homesteads feed the Manner and open one more of every building line.

tribes.name: Pale Host
tribes.text: Along the Pale Coast, the Pale Host hide bowmen in sea mist. Their tide lines rain arrows on every road that approaches the court.

preliminaries.name: Turn the Tide Lines
preliminaries.text: Drive the bowmen from the tide lines before they warn the court.

preliminaries.name: Scatter the Mist
preliminaries.text: Break the mist camp and scatter the bowmen guarding the coast.

intel.army: Enemy bowmen holding the tide lines beneath the sea mist
intel.tactics: Ranged arrow volleys, bowmen summons and a desperate final enrage
intel.weakness: Use armored defenders and overlapping towers to answer the ranged pressure
intel.reward: The Pale Coast roads, court stores and shore join the Manner.

annex.name: Rebuild as an Outpost
annex.text: A fortified coastal base: two more of every building line may stand.

annex.name: Dismantle for Materials
annex.text: Strip the court for shore timber, plate and cold coin.

annex.name: Frontier Settlement
annex.text: Coastal homesteads feed the Manner and open one more of every building line.

tribes.name: Ember Legion
tribes.text: On Starwatch Ridge, the Ember Legion drill veteran infantry and siege engines into disciplined lines. Their marshal commands the highest passes, and every redoubt answers his horn.

preliminaries.name: Break the Vanguard
preliminaries.text: Break the veteran vanguard before its disciplined lines close the ridge road.

preliminaries.name: Storm the Redoubt
preliminaries.text: Storm the siege redoubt and cut its engines off from the throne.

intel.army: Veteran infantry, ranged guards and siege engines in disciplined lines
intel.tactics: Slams the yard, summons wall-breakers and enrages when his line breaks
intel.weakness: Layer pikes and tower fire while repair crews answer the siege pressure
intel.reward: The Starwatch Ridge passes, throne stores and heights join the Manner.

annex.name: Rebuild as an Outpost
annex.text: A fortified ridge base: two more of every building line may stand.

annex.name: Dismantle for Materials
annex.text: Strip the throne for siege timber, plate and cold coin.

annex.name: Frontier Settlement
annex.text: Ridge homesteads feed the Manner and open one more of every building line.
